subject.title: Bug: Feishu DM Session Enters Infinite Loop After Subagent Announce Trigger

question: Should this remain a distinct maintainer-owned bug for the subagent-announce no-user DIRECT loop, or be consolidated under the broader Feishu slow-run/session-loop cluster?
rationale: The remaining safe fix crosses Feishu live behavior, generic subagent completion handoff, session history pressure, and autonomous-run policy, so automation should not choose the product boundary.

options.title: Keep Distinct And Prove
options.body: Keep this issue open for a focused live Feishu replay and a generic subagent/session guard that specifically prevents no-user DIRECT loops.

options.title: Consolidate Under Feishu Cluster
options.body: Close or link this only after maintainers explicitly decide that https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/90559 owns the remaining Feishu loop work.

options.title: Split Runtime Policy First
options.body: Open a narrower maintainer-authored runtime policy item for autonomous no-user runs and leave Feishu-specific queue work in the existing channel cluster.

recommendation.title: Keep Distinct And Prove
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open for a focused live Feishu replay and a generic subagent/session guard that specifically prevents no-user DIRECT loops.

likelyOwner.reason: The relevant history spans both generic subagent lifecycle/delivery and Feishu queue policy, and this account appears in both areas' recent commit history.
